app.languageFailed: Couldn't load the interface language, so everything is in Ukrainian. Check your connection.
app.devPanelFailed: Mock panel didn't load. Click to try again

appearancePage.title: Themes & appearance
appearancePage.lead: Palette, theme, density and sidebar switches on <html> (SPEC §6.2).

motion.title: Motion
motion.lead: Functional animation only: enter and exit, expanding, highlighting changes, progress. Durations and easing come from tokens; prefers-reduced-motion turns motion off (ADR-0009).

uses.duration-base: panels, sidebar, expanding rows and groups

primitivesPage.title: Primitives
primitivesPage.lead: shadcn/ui on Base UI, Nova style, rebuilt on erp-ui tokens (ADR-0001, ADR-0006).

readOnly.label: VAT rate
readOnly.hint: Read-only: available to the Accountant role

dialog.title: Delete invoice No. {{number}}?
dialog.description: The invoice and its lines will be deleted. Payments stay in the bank journal.

formatsPage.title: Languages & formats
formatsPage.lead: Ukrainian and English; numbers, amounts and dates via Intl; LC12 identifiers with masks and checksums (SPEC §11).

numbers.title: Numbers & amounts
numbers.description: Money is integer minor units + currency code; hryvnia shows ₴, other currencies show their code.

dates.title: Dates & time
dates.description: Explicit formats only; 24-hour time; examples use the Europe/Kyiv time zone.
dates.calendarDate: Calendar date “{{value}}” does not shift with the time zone

relative.title: Relative time
relative.description: For timelines and “Updated…”; after a week, a date.

ids.title: Identifiers & phone (LC12)
ids.description: Masks while typing; validation on leaving the field, then while correcting (SPEC §8.3).

words.title: Amount in words
words.description: For invoices, certificates and contracts. The document language is set apart from the interface language; minor units are digits.

zones.title: Time zones
zones.description: Timestamps use the time zone from the user's profile; calendar dates are not shifted (SPEC §11).

controls.title: Appearance
controls.sidebarHint: In the dark theme the sidebar is always dark.

user.signedOut: Signing out works only in a real app

iconsPage.title: Icons
iconsPage.lead: Concept → icon dictionary (lib/icons): modules, statuses, document actions, shell; a custom hryvnia icon.
iconsPage.hryvniaHint: Other lucide currency icons next to it for a style check.
iconsPage.strokeHint: The same across the app (IconProvider). Comparing 1.5 · 1.75 · 2.

statesPage.title: Page states
statesPage.lead: Required collection states (SPEC §8.1): default texts come from kit strings, the action comes from the screen.

modulePage.lead: Module {{id}} is not built yet, but the shell already leads to it.
modulePage.description: Module screens arrive in their wave (SPEC §16). This shows a section without data.

dataPage.title: Data & mocks
dataPage.lead: Stress page: 10,000 invoices from the MSW mock server through the ra-core dataProvider. Scrolling in windows of 100 rows or pages, server-side filters and sorting, “page / all” selection, bulk approval as a background job, editing the client and the amount in a cell, permissions and version conflicts. Server scenarios are in the developer panel.
dataPage.editDescription: Changes are saved with the record version: if someone has already saved something else, a conflict dialog appears.
dataPage.readOnlyHint: Editing is available to the Accountant role

approve.hint: Approving invoices is available to the Accountant role
approve.description: Only drafts up to 350,000.00 UAH can be approved. Other invoices stay as they are, and the summary shows why. The job runs on the server: you can leave the page.

reasons.invalid_status: Not a draft: only drafts can be approved
reasons.locked: Someone else is editing this invoice right now

invoicePage.title: Invoice {{number}}
invoicePage.commentSoon: Comments, files and followers will arrive with the record feed in wave 1.
invoicePage.approveDescription: Only a draft up to 350,000.00 UAH can be approved. The job runs on the server; the result appears in a notification.

organizationsPage.title: Organizations
organizationsPage.lead: The List Report template with pages on the organizations directory: the pin keeps a record at the top of the list for you only (in the order you pinned, at most 50), and “Rows per page” is remembered for this list on the server. The name opens a record page with tabs.

notes.lead: Notes about {{name}}: a project tab from the extension file.
notes.hint: Its code loads separately, only when the tab is opened; the module's record page files did not change for it.

authDemo.accountant: Accountant and administrator (“Sign in as…”): password demo; app, SMS and email code 123456; backup code ab12cd34; passkey
authDemo.sales: Sales manager, read-only: password demo, no second step
authDemo.temporary: New colleague with temporary password temp-password (sets their own)
authDemo.lead: Team lead: sees people and roles, changes nothing and can't see history; password demo
authDemo.platform: Platform administrator outside companies: changes the app's security policy; password demo
authDemo.inviteAccount: Open an invitation for an existing account (Ivan)
authDemo.captcha: Demo “not a bot” check (projects use Cloudflare Turnstile)
authDemo.openLink: Open the link from the email
authDemo.noticeToast: Email to {{to}}: your sign-in email was changed
authDemo.exportToast: Email to {{to}}: your data archive is ready
authDemo.ssoLead: This is the provider step: choose an account or cancel. Real sign-in opens the Google or Apple page.
authDemo.newSignInToast: Email to {{to}}: new sign-in to your account
authDemo.recoveryToast: Email to {{to}}: your access recovery request was received
authDemo.factorsResetToast: Email to {{to}}: an administrator reset your two-step verification

securityPage.title: Account security
securityPage.lead: Sign-in methods, password, email, devices and sign-in history, data export and account deletion. Sensitive actions ask you to confirm it's you.

usersPage.title: Users
usersPage.lead: Company users. An administrator manages access (sessions, two-step verification, blocking) and can sign in as a user to look into a request. Everything goes to the audit log.
usersPage.sessionsDescription: Where company users are signed in right now; end any suspicious session.
usersPage.invitationsDescription: Your colleague gets an email with a link and sets their own name and password. The link is valid for 7 days.

profilePage.title: Profile
profilePage.lead: Photo, name, job title, contact phone, time zone and email signature.

securityPolicyPage.title: Security policies
securityPolicyPage.lead: What to require from every user: two-step verification, sign-in methods, password, session, allowed addresses. Changes ask you to confirm it's you.

notificationsPage.title: Notification settings
notificationsPage.lead: Which events to notify you about and where: in the app, by email, push, Telegram. Quiet hours follow your time zone.

auditPage.title: Audit log
auditPage.lead: Who did what and when in the company: sign-ins, security, users, integrations, record changes. Change an invoice on the “Data & mocks” page and the event appears here.

integrationsPage.title: Integrations
integrationsPage.lead: Webhooks notify external systems about events. API tokens for incoming requests live in “Account security”.
integrationsPage.webhooksDescription: Event subscriptions: URL, events, signing secret, delivery log.

rolesPage.title: Roles & permissions
rolesPage.lead: What each role can do: permissions by resource and action. A person gets the sum of all their roles; assign roles to a user in “Users” → “Access”. Every change goes to the audit log.

companyPage.title: Company
companyPage.lead: Details of the current company for invoices, acts and emails; logo and stamp; branches. An administrator edits them, everyone else can view.
companyPage.profileDescription: EDRPOU, RNOKPP, VAT IPN and IBAN are checked by checksum, just like on the server.
companyPage.imagesDescription: Placed in the header and signature area of documents.
companyPage.branchesDescription: Separate divisions: name, code and address appear in documents.

inboxPage.title: Notifications
inboxPage.lead: Everything the app told you: overdue invoices, mentions, tasks, security events. Choose events and channels in “Notification settings”.

fieldsPage.title: Dates & numbers
fieldsPage.lead: Date field with keyboard entry and a calendar, period with presets, time, amounts and numbers in the interface language format (UI39, SPEC §11).

dates.title: Date field
dates.description: Type the digits, separators appear by themselves; the calendar opens with the button next to it. Checked when you leave the field.
dates.bounded: Due date: from today to +90 days

range.title: Period
range.description: A preset applies at once; the calendar and the From/To fields apply with Done.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Weeks start on Monday, ISO week numbers, “today” in the user's time zone.

numbers.title: Amounts & numbers
numbers.description: Amounts are whole minor units plus a currency; grouping and decimals follow the interface language.

formsPage.title: Forms
formsPage.lead: react-hook-form + zod: checks when you leave a field, an error summary, server errors next to the field, unsaved changes protection; three levels of confirmation (ADR-0015, SPEC §8.2, §8.3).

form.title: Invoice
form.description: Try saving an empty form, entering a taken number or leaving the page without saving.
form.numberHint: Number {{taken}} is already taken: the server returns an error next to the field.
form.amountHint: The amount in words will appear here
form.companyHint: Only an administrator can change this, so the field is read-only.
form.taken: This number already exists. Choose another

confirm.title: Confirming actions
confirm.description: Three levels (SPEC §8.2): a reversible action shows an Undo toast; deletion asks in a dialog with a button that names the result; a critical action needs a typed word.
confirm.deleteDescription: Invoices РФ-0012, РФ-0013 and РФ-0014 will be deleted.
confirm.deleteCompanyDescription: All documents, counterparties and users of the company will be gone. They cannot be restored.

pickersPage.title: Record picker and details
pickersPage.lead: Record picker with server search and “Create…” (UI40), values with a Copy button (UI43): the building blocks of module B1 “Contacts and companies”.

contact.title: Contact and company
contact.lead: The company is searched on the server by name or code. If it is not there, “Create…” opens a form with the search text, and the new company becomes the field value. Signed in as Ivan (sales manager), “Create” is unavailable with a reason, and the owner list shows only the names and emails of active colleagues (the directory available without the right to view people).
contact.name: Full name
contact.createDenied: The Accountant and Sales manager roles can create organizations
contact.ownerHint: Optional: a user of the company

states.title: Field states
states.lead: Empty, filled, with an error, read-only (the field stays focusable and is read by screen readers), disabled; a record that no longer exists (SPEC §8.3).
states.filledHint: The label comes from the record by id

list.title: List states
list.lead: A mock scenario for organizations only: searching, no matches, error with retry, offline, no access (SPEC §8.1). The developer panel sets the same.
list.pickerHint: Open the list after changing the scenario

multi.title: Several values from a list
multi.lead: Multi-select (UI40): selected values as tags in the field, a list with search that stays open after a pick, a bottom sheet with Done on phones. Module B1 picks segments this way.

multiStates.title: Multi-select states
multiStates.lead: Field: empty, filled, many values, with an error, read-only, disabled, a value that is no longer in the list. List: loading, failed to load with retry, empty (SPEC §8.1, §8.3).
multiStates.filledHint: Labels come from the list by key
multiStates.manyHint: Tags wrap to the next line
multiStates.missingHint: You can remove it in the list
multiStates.failedHint: Open the list and press Try again

requisites.title: Details with Copy
requisites.lead: Shown for people, copied as stored: IBAN without spaces, phone as +380. Email and phone are links; an empty value has no button (UI43).

create.title: New organization
create.lead: Add the other details on the organization page.
create.name: Name
